en: Christmas is over, and before I\nknew it, New Year's is just\naround the corner!

Actually, around this time of year, more
people in the Federation go back to
their hometowns, so we AIs end up with
nothing to do...
That's why I just lounge around\nonce Christmas is finished.
Oh, you're the same, Captain!\nIt's so easy to just relax, isn't\nit?

When I go home for the end of
the year, I dive into the
kotatsu, lie back and eat
tangerines with the TV on...
HEY!! You two, come help with\nthe big cleaning!!
Coro, you're scrubbing the\nhallways; Captain, you're wiping\nthe Bridge windows!
And from the outside of the\nship, of course!!
From the outside is a bit\nmuch...!
Where is your an-swer?
Y-yes, ma'am!!
Event achievement unlocked!\nYou can check it via the\nachievement button.
Happy New Year! Happy New\nYear to you!
Thinking about another year\nstarting really does make me\nfeel refreshed and focused.

Captain, thank you so much for
saving me when I was stranded
and confused on that
wilderness planet.
I'm looking forward to another\nyear with you. Let's get back\nto Earth together!
Yeah, me too.
Also, oh, um, here... I'd be\nhappy if you'd accept this as a\ntoken of my appreciation...
Captain!! Happy New Year!!
Captain, I'm looking forward to\nworking with you again this\nyear!
Captain, speaking of the New\nYear!!
Give New Year's gift.
Request New Year's gift.
Speaking of the New Year?
Thanks for the business!
I mean, what are you even\ngoing to do with all that New\nYear's money?
Oh, that's easy!
I'm going to build a greenhouse\non the ship and turn it into a\nbanana plantation!
What!?
I've finally realized something...

That the Captain, who loves
bananas, isn't satisfied with
just the ones from the
Replicator.

From now on, I will devote my
heart and soul to growing
fresh, juicy, and nutrient-rich
bananas at all times!

Now, there's no time to waste! I
must research the optimal soil
for each variety and implement
strict temperature control!
I just hope the Bridge doesn't\nturn into a jungle.
Waaaah! Please don't knock me\nover!!
All the New Year's money\neveryone gave me is falling\nout!!
It's okay, it's okay. The Captain\nand I will manage Coro's New\nYear's money for him.
Wait, I have a feeling I'm never\ngetting that back...!

What are you talking about?
We'll manage it properly, so
don't worry and hand it all
over.
Wawa! Not any more...!
Oopsie!
When you think of the New\nYear, you've gotta have mochi!
Look, there's some\ndelicious-looking mochi right\nhere.

Wait, those are the Kagami
mochi that were supposed to
be my snack on the day of
Kagami Biraki...
Hmm? I can't get them off the\nstand...
Why don't we just toast the\nwhole thing?
Wait, hold on!!
Oh, Captain, did you get the\nshichirin grill and the mesh\nready? Thanks!
Eek! Captain, Eve! Please don't\nroast me right at the start of\nthe New Year!
A present from Eve! You can\ncheck it via the Achievements\nbutton.
